pose_rule: Front-quarter left forward stride: left foot planted far ahead, right foot on its toe behind, left knee bent, torso leaning forward, and elbows bent naturally.
prompt: Use the supplied front full-body reference as the fixed source for the entire figure and pose change. Use the supplied ordered face sheet to preserve the same face and hair across its front and target-direction panels. Render the same full-body figure, left front-quarter view facing toward image left, Front-quarter left forward stride: left foot planted far ahead, right foot on its toe behind, left knee bent, torso leaning forward, and elbows bent naturally. hard_fail_conditions: The figure does not show exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, and two feet.

Any visible hand does not show five separate fingers including the thumb.

decision: Human approved as an unstyled Stage-1 pose anchor; use only as input to Stage 2, not directly for LoRA training.
